## READ DATA (concat vcf all IDS)


```{r ps1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE,  fig.width=18, fig.height=8, paged.print=FALSE}

# noLD
pca <- read_table(paste0(dataDir,"/chaffinch_bluefinch_miss0.5_mac3_noZ_noLD_microbiomeSamples.eigenvec"), col_names = FALSE)

eigenval <- scan(paste0(dataDir,"/chaffinch_bluefinch_miss0.5_mac3_noZ.eigenval"))


# sort out the pca data
# remove nuisance column
colnames(pca) <- pca[1,]
pca <- pca[-1,-1]
# set names

pca$IID
names(pca)[1] <- "WGS_ID"
#names(pca)[1] <- "TipID"

names(pca)[2:ncol(pca)] <- paste0("PC", 1:(ncol(pca)-1))

metadata <- read_delim(paste0(dataDir, "/WGS_Fringilla_samples.tsv"), delim = ",")
metadata %>% data.frame %>% head
metadata <- metadata %>% filter(Microb == 1) 

pca <- left_join(pca, metadata, by ="WGS_ID")

pca %>% names
as.data.frame(table(pca$Region_Species))
as.data.frame(table(pca$Label))

pca %>% group_by(Species, Label) %>% summarise(Nsamples =n()) %>% data.frame

# relevel
pca$Species <- as.factor(pca$Species)
pca$Species <- relevel(pca$Species, "Fringilla coelebs coelebs")
levels(pca$Species)
table(pca$Species)

pca$Species_Label <- as.factor(pca$Species_Label)
pca$Species_Label <- relevel(pca$Species_Label, "Mainland_F_coelebs")

pca$Chaff_Blue <- ifelse(pca$Species == "Fringilla polatzeki" | pca$Species == "Fringilla teydea", "Bluefinch", "Chaffinch")
table(pca$Chaff_Blue)

# first convert to percentage variance explained
(pve <- data.frame(PC = 1:10, pve = eigenval/sum(eigenval)*100))

# calculate the cumulative sum of the percentage variance explained
cumsum(pve$pve)

```

Plot Species Label 

```{r ps1, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, tidy=TRUE,  fig.width=18, fig.height=8, paged.print=FALSE}


(pca_species_pc1_2 <- ggplot(data = pca, mapping = aes(x = as.numeric(PC1), y = as.numeric(PC2),fill = Label, shape = Label), show.legend = FALSE ) +
 geom_point(size = 10, guide = "none",  color = "black")  +
scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,23,22,21, 25, 21,21,22, 21, 21, 25),guide = "none")+
 labs(title = "",
    x = paste0("PC 1 (",signif(pve$pve[1], 3)," %)"),
    y = paste0("PC 2 (",signif(pve$pve[2], 3), " %)"))  + SpeciesLabel.color + SpeciesLabel.fill +
 scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.01))+
 pca_theme) 

(pca_species_pc1_3 <- ggplot(data = pca, mapping = aes(x = as.numeric(PC1), y = as.numeric(PC3),fill = Label, shape = Label), show.legend = FALSE ) +
```
